title: Brookton's Market
author: Unknown author
description: “William Gale had a tin shop on this site for a few years before the Civil War. Then brothers Frank, Charles, and Fred Mulks operated the store well into the 1920s. The Post Office was at the back with its own door, and while Fred Mulks operated the store, he also served as postmaster. A plaster mill once stood on the site of the present store’s parking lot.”1 The building won the Historic Ithaca
